description: This Perl script 'packinfo.pl' analyzes the output of 'git verify-pack -v', providing statistics about Git object packs such as object sizes, delta chains, delta trees, and optional filename annotations. It includes command-line options to output delta trees, filenames, and detailed dumps, serving as a diagnostic tool for Git pack files.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical measures (count, total, min, max, mean, median, std deviation) for a list of numeric data.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Formats and prints statistical summaries for a dataset with a label.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses object graph, accumulating sizes, path sizes, and optional printing of delta trees.
